description: Defines a template class TlsEnabled for managing TLS configuration in WebSocket connections, including certificate handling, TLS context setup, and verification.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing TLS setup and certificate management for WebSocket clients.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the TLS certificate.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the private key.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate filenames.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes TLS handler for the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines if TLS connection is authenticated based on connection error codes.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures the SSL context for TLS.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context.
